package.previous_candidate_failure: The old candidate's resized 4:3 Stats capture clipped or dropped glyph letters because the glyph cache key omitted raster width and actual RGBA/image dimensions. That failure is retained as history and does not describe the replacement captures.

visual_evidence.observation: The live Stats page uses the source menu frame, portrait, tab strip, left attribute rows and right statistics panel. Pixel inspection shows a coherent full-window composition at 1200x720. It is a fresh diagnostic Warrior profile: header PLAYER / WARRIOR LVL: 1, 0 points, Strength 10, unlike reference-391/393 (CRISP82 / Warrior Lvl: 2, 2 or 0 points and different attributes). Therefore this is layout/render evidence, not matched-state visual parity.

At 1600x900 after a logged resize, the Stats art and text still fill the window without letterboxing. The viewport implementation uses source FlashCamera SetBounds mode 0 behavior: independent width and height scales from 480x320, with zero translation; release hit tests divide by those same independent axis scales.

PASS for glyph legibility at 960x720 after resize. I inspected the full frame: Stats, Player, Warrior Lvl: 1, HP/MP/EXP, Points Left 0, Strength 10, Dexterity 5, Endurance 8, Energy 3, R-DAM 13–17, Attack Rating 69, Melee Crit 5%, Defense Rating 36, Armor 4, and all Resistances labels/values are complete and readable. The selected Stats tab is red and the zero-points presentation is gray, consistent with source frame style. This is a fresh diagnostic profile, not a matched-state recreation of reference-391/393.

PASS as a fresh 960x720 baseline. All Stats labels and numeric fields listed above remain fully legible; class header and selected red Stats tab are intact, with Points Left 0 displayed. Independent raw PPM comparison against the resized capture found zero changed channel values in verifier crop [120,310,410,365] (the full Strength label/value region): 47,850 channel values compared, 0 changed. Full frames differ in unrelated pixels, so this crop result is not represented as a whole-frame equality.

At 1201x720, the engaged Bogwomp scene displays complete yellow 32 and orange Miss labels. The text remains readable in the fresh-resolution screenshot; the matching result log reports source damage of 32.2539 and zero-damage Miss.

Rendered combat includes yellow damage number 32 and orange Miss near the engaged Bogwomp after resizing to 1600x900. The log associates them with synchronous original melee results (32.2539 damage and zero-damage Miss) and reports two labels over 39 drawn frames. This demonstrates the scoped result-to-presentation path; full original CUI call order remains incomplete.

The restore run logs damage, Miss, a lethal 16-damage result, then successful checkpoint restoration at frame 130. Its report confirms three captured results and a clean exit. This is a deterministic diagnostic combat/save path, not campaign save acceptance.

The fresh default route shows a rendered swamp walkway, player portrait/health/mana and multiple placed characters. The camera/actor arrangement is not matched to an identified reference frame, and the full mobile HUD controls are absent. It supports a default-world rendering claim only; the source video audit still says normal entrances and population selection are unresolved.

source_contract_checks.presentation_observer: PlayableActorWorld calls the optional result observer synchronously after original damage resolution and before queuing the result. Observer failure records a presentation diagnostic; it does not reject damage or suppress the original result. The host drains and prints those diagnostics. The live adapter's observer snapshots the result and pre-motion target position; tests check unchanged HP, same-frame idempotence, zero-damage not fabricating Miss, caller-owned frame time, and clear-on-reload. This validates a read-only presentation seam, not complete original HUD scheduling/CUI order.

conclusion: The 79e566...7819d8 replacement fixes the specific 4:3 resized menu glyph defect: both fresh and resized 960x720 captures are fully legible, and the Strength label/value crop matches byte-for-byte across all RGB channels. The earlier 235823...11f5 capture remains a documented failure and is superseded. This closes only the inspected Stats resize/glyph issue. Equipment, Skills, Faery live integration, normal campaign entrances/population, matched-state movement/video parity, and whole-game coverage remain incomplete; package/component passes do not establish release acceptance.
